question: Certain autoimmune diseases have been associated with genetic deficiencies of the complement system. Specifically, the deficiency in C4 has been associated with:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Deficiency in C4 -> Impaired clearance of immune complexes -> Increased risk of autoimmune diseases -> 80% CHAIN: Deficiency in C4 -> Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) -> 70% CHAIN: Deficiency in C4 -> Activation of the classical complement pathway -> Tissue damage and inflammation -> Autoimmune diseases like SLE -> 75% CHAIN: Deficiency in C4 -> Increased susceptibility to immune dysregulation -> Development of autoimmune diseases -> 80%
analysis: Deficiency in C4 has been specifically associated with systemic lupus erythematosus, a chronic autoimmune disease.
